arxiv-2012-09270.title: Who is the best coach of all time? A network-based assessment of the career performance of professional sports coaches
arxiv-2012-09270.creator: Şirag Erkol, Filippo Radicchi
arxiv-2012-09270.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Şirag Erkol, Filippo Radicchi. We consider two large datasets consisting of all games played among top-tier European soccer clubs in the last 60 60 years, and among professional American basketball teams in the past 70 70 years. We leverage game data to build networks of pairwise interactions between the head coaches of the teams, and measure their career performance in terms of network centrality metrics.

arxiv-2110-05523.title: UnfairGAN: An Enhanced Generative Adversarial Network for Raindrop Removal from A Single Image
arxiv-2110-05523.creator: Duc Manh Nguyen, Sang-Woong Lee
arxiv-2110-05523.description: Abstract Image deraining is a new challenging problem in real-world applications, such as autonomous vehicles. In a bad weather condition of heavy rainfall, raindrops, mainly hitting glasses or windshields, can significantly reduce observation ability. Moreover, raindrops spreading over the glass can yield refraction’s physical effect, which seriously impedes the sightline or undermine machine learning systems.

arxiv-2208-02478.creator: Ron Donagi, Nadia Ott
arxiv-2208-02478.description: Abstract . The bad locus in the moduli of super Riemann surfaces with Ramond punctures parametrizes those super Riemann surfaces that have more than the expected number of independent closed holomorphic 1-forms. There is a super period map that depends on certain discrete choices.

arxiv-2305-19359.title: Scalable evaluation of incoherent infidelity in quantum devices
arxiv-2305-19359.creator: Jader P. Santos, I. Henao, Raam Uzdin
arxiv-2305-19359.description: Abstract Quantum processors can already execute tasks beyond the reach of classical simulation, albeit for artificial problems. At this point, it is essential to design error metrics that test the experimental accuracy of quantum algorithms with potential for a practical quantum advantage. The distinction between coherent errors and incoherent errors is crucial, as they often involve different error suppression tools.

arxiv-2310-03880.title: Linear cooling of a levitated micromagnetic cylinder by vibration
arxiv-2310-03880.creator: Chris Timberlake, Elliot Simcox, Hendrik Ulbricht
arxiv-2310-03880.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chris Timberlake, Elliot Simcox, Hendrik Ulbricht. We report feedback cooling of translational and librational degrees of freedom of a levitated micromagnet cylinder, utilizing a piezoelectric actuator to apply linear feedback to high-Q mechanical modes. The normal modes are measured with a superconducting pick-up coil coupled to a DC SQUID, and phase information is fed back to the piezoelectric actuator to feedback cool a center-of-mass mode to 1.8 ± 1 1.8\pm 1 K, and a librational mode to 830 ± 200 830\pm 200 mK.

arxiv-2412-10944.creator: Honglian Wang, Sijing Tu, Aristides Gionis
arxiv-2412-10944.description: Abstract . Diversification is a useful tool for exploring large collections of information items. pmc-12376861.title: Density functional theory analysis of the structural, electronic, elastic, phonon dispersion and AIMD properties of KMgX3 (X = O, S, Se)
pmc-12376861.creator: Mazhar Haleem Awan, Sehrish Munsif, Huma Habib

pmc-12531897.creator: Hsing‐Fang Lu, Su Boon‐Yong, Chi‐Ya Yang, Jiu‐Yao Wang, Yen‐Ting Chang, Fuu‐Jen Tsai
pmc-12531897.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectivesEosinophilia, characterised by elevated eosinophil levels, is associated with various allergic and inflammatory conditions. This study aimed to elucidate the genetic determinants of eosinophil levels by examining polygenic risk scores (PRS) and identifying significant single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs).MethodsWe conducted a comprehensive genome‐wide association study (GWAS) on eosinophil levels using a large cohort, comprising 221 851 controls (eosinophil levels ≤ 5%) and 11 200 cases (eosinophil levels > 5%) in Taiwan.

pmc-13217901.creator: Armand Totouom, Gadom Djal-Gadom
pmc-13217901.description: Low levels of women’s empowerment probably constitute a key obstacle to healthcare utilization in Africa, given the importance of gender inequalities in this region. This paper examines the link between women’s empowerment and health facility childbirth in Cameroon.
